title: Hidden Power Of The 72 Rule

scenes.text: How $1,000 can become $8,000 in just 24 years
At an 8% annual return, money doubles every 9 years (72 ÷ 8)
scenes.label: 8% DOUBLES IN 9 YEARS

scenes.text: Invest $1,000 now and let compounding turn it into $2,000 after 9 years
scenes.label: START WITH $1,000

scenes.text: Keep the money invested for another 9 years and it reaches $4,000, then $8,000 after 24 years total

description: The Rule of 72 shows how modest returns explode over time. Use this quick math to plan your investments and watch small sums grow huge. Follow for more easy wealth formulas.
